title: Waiver of Foreign Domestic Worker Levy for Families with Three or More Children Aged Under 16
what_it_is: Waiver of Foreign Domestic Worker Levy for Families with Three or More Children Aged Under 16

sections.label: Number of FDWs in Singapore
sections.summary: In 2018, Singapore had over 250,000 foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2018, there were over 250,000 FDWs in Singapore.

sections.label: FDW levy rates and family support
sections.summary: The levy was last adjusted in April 2019 to $300 monthly for employers without caregiving needs, while those with caregiving needs pay $60, with no plans to reduce it further.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The levy is regularly reviewed and was last adjusted in April 2019 to $300 a month for employers without caregiving needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, families with caregiving needs continue to enjoy the FDW concessionary levy rate of $60 a month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Currently, there are no plans to further reduce the FDW concessionary levy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, the Baby Bonus Cash Gift, Child Development Account and MediSave Grant for Newborns provide parents with up to $18,000 per child for their first and second child and up to $26,000 per child for their third and fourth child and up to $32,000 per child for their fifth and subsequent child.

sections.label: FDW concessionary levy and preschool measures
sections.summary: About 80% of FDW employers enjoy the $60 concessionary levy, saving $240 monthly, and the Prime Minister announced preschool education measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Over the last three years, in fact, the majority of our FDW employers, that is, about 80% of our FDW employers enjoy the concessionary levy of $60 a month, which translates into a saving of $240 a month per FDW.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: If Members remember, a few months ago, Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong, during the National Day Rally, announced a series of measures to further boost preschool education, for example, to increase the total number of Government-supported preschools from the current 50% to 80% over time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: At the same time, he also announced that more middle-income families will benefit from additional preschool subsidies with the increase of the income ceiling from $7,500 to $12,000.
